stories.title: Rodgers says he's done with Steelers, claims McCarthy asleep in meetings
stories.summary: Quarterback Aaron Rodgers said Wednesday on "The Pat McAfee Show" that he won't return to the Steelers after his stunning benching and alleges that coach Mike McCarthy has been sleeping in meetings.

stories.title: Aiyuk to sign with Commanders, will reunite with college QB Daniels
stories.summary: Wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk is signing with the Commanders on their practice squad, agent Drew Rosenhaus told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Falcons 'aware' of insinuations Pearce still trying to contact ex Jackson
stories.summary: Kevin Stefanski said he and the team are aware of assertions made by Rickea Jackson that insinuated James Pearce Jr. is still trying to contact her.

stories.title: Former Bucks guard Porter finalizing 2-year deal to join Magic, agent says
stories.summary: Free agent guard Kevin Porter Jr. is finalizing a two-year contract with the Magic, his agent told ESPN.

stories.title: MLB sues players' union, asking court to declare lockout legal
stories.summary: Major League Baseball sued its players' association in federal court Wednesday, asking that the league's contemplated lockout next week be declared legal.
